name: Collateral Value Query V 02
definition: The CollateralValueQuery message is sent by a system member (such as a directly connected party) to the system transaction administrator to query the current available value of securities for auto collateralisation for one specific or several cash accounts.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Set of elements to identify the collateral value query message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
